subject: Malaysia M-510 TiO2 for Mathys water-based wall paints
body:
Mathys offers PARACEM DECO EASY FINISH XTRA MATT, a water-based interior wall paint. Your Halen purchasing role also covers raw materials.

We manufacture Malaysia-origin M-510 rutile TiO2, with water-based wall paints and zirconium/aluminium treatment listed in its TDS.

Could you route this to Martin Mathys' raw-material purchasing team so I can provide the M-510 technical sheet?
